thread:
Carmen L: Quick sync 60we're targeting Tue 09:00 PT for the public post. Need a hard changelog URL + docs preview link by EOD so we can finalize social copy and press note.
Omar V: Changelog is ready at https://redwood.ai/changelog/release-1-2-preview (finalizing). Highlights: streaming latency reductions, smarter prefix caching, Dedicated capacity tuning.
Carmen L: Marketing wants one short headline, one longer subhead, and 2 tweet-length blurbs for A/B testing. Can you also confirm a commit hash so legal can reference it in the embargo note?
Omar V: Commit: 9f3b2a1. I updated the changelog with that hash. Also added a "known limitations" note about console flags in eu regions.
Priya E: Perfect. We'll run A/B headline tests: Headline A = "Faster streaming, smarter caching 	6 Redwood 1.2"; Headline B = "Redwood 1.2: interactive apps, lower latency". We'll schedule tweets at T+5 and T+25 minutes.
Yvonne S: Docs preview link: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/release-1-2 (auth: staging-sso). Screenshots attached in PR #589. Note: a few config pages still behind feature flags until global rollout.
Deploy Bot: Canary schedule set 	 Tue 01:45 PT -> canary-usw2; smoke checks: /run/smoke-1 ; on-fail: rollback-v1 ; job id: 77721.
Carmen L: Embargo plan: press embargo until Tue 08:30 PT. Press contact list pinned in the announce doc. @Legal Bot can you verify the embargo clause?
Legal Bot: Reviewed embargo language. Replace "GA" with "available to reserved customers" and add the commit hash (9f3b2a1). Approved for embargo.
Omar V: For inbound lead routing, please use webhook: https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-v1-2 ; required payload: name, email, company, interest_level. Optional: company_size, use_case_tags.
Priya E: Can you paste sample webhook JSON so frontend can wire forms?
Omar V: Sample payload:
```
POST /lead-v1-2
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "name": "Dana Example",
  "email": "dana@example.com",
  "company": "Acme",
  "interest_level": "high",
  "company_size": "51-200",
  "use_case_tags": ["chat","search"],
  "utm_campaign": "launch_1_2",
  "source": "webinar"
}
```
Priya E: Nice. We'll ask the form to include company_size as a dropdown and pass use_case_tags as checkboxes. CRM mapping: tag all as "launch_1_2" and set owner to the inbound team.
Yvonne S: Webinar is Wed 10am PT. Speakers: Omar (tech), Priya (product), Carmen (customer stories). Landing page up: /events/1-2-launch. We'll capture utm_campaign=launch_1_2_webinar.
Carmen L: One more ask 	 mark all benchmark numbers in the public post as "preliminary internal benchmarks" and link the bench run: https://bench.redwood.ai/run/4579. Otherwise legal flags the claim.
Omar V: Done 	 added that qualifier to the changelog and the release note.
Deploy Bot: Maintenance window conflict detected: canary-usw2 has infra patch Tue 01:30 PT. Suggested canary shift to Tue 02:15 PT.
Priya E: Let's shift to 02:15 PT, update the timeline accordingly and notify oncall.
Carmen L: Rollback owner? Need a single point person during launch window.
Omar V: I'll own rollback for the launch. Runbook link: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/rollback-1-2. Steps summarized in the doc with metrics to watch (error rate, p50, p95, cpu).
Yvonne S: Also adding a tiny FAQ section to docs for customers (SSO setup, Dedicated capacity pricing link). PR incoming.
Carmen L: Final checklist added to the announce doc. I'll post the final copy by 4pm PT for a quick legal + eng micro-review. If the changelog or docs arent live by then, we hold the post. :white_check_mark: :rocket:
